basic_details.job_title: DLSA Moradabad Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Legal Services Authority, Moradabad (DLSA Moradabad) has announced contractual vacancies for the post of Para Legal Volunteer, with applications to be submitted directly or by registered post to District Legal Services Authority, Moradabad on or before 22 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Eligible applicants must be literate with preference given to Matriculate pass, while advocates are not eligible to apply. The selection process consists of selection followed by training, and selected local persons will serve a 1-year tenure from the date of successful completion of training across Moradabad

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Must be literate, with preference given to Matriculate pass applicants. Advocates are not eligible to apply. | Eligible Categories / Backgrounds: Retired teachers, retired government employees and senior citizens, social work postgraduates and teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors/physicians, NSS and law students, non-political service-oriented NGOs and clubs, women neighbourhood groups, Mahila Mandal, Maitri Sangh and other self-help groups, long-term prisoners who have served sentences with good conduct, and any other person deemed suitable by DLSA or Tehsil Legal Services Committee. | Special Preference Categories: Exceptional sportspersons, distinguished artists, and exceptional/talented persons who have demonstrated notable skills in any field. | Age Limit: Minimum age of 18 years; no upper age limit.

selection_process: The selection process involves screening and shortlisting of applications followed by training. Selected volunteers serve a 1-year tenure from the date of successful completion of training.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed format (Form-01) along with self-attested copies of educational certificates, mark sheets, and Aadhaar card. Applications can be submitted directly or sent through registered post to the office of the District Legal Services Authority, Moradabad.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Must be literate, with preference given to Matriculate pass applicants. Advocates are not eligible to apply. Eligible Categories / Backgrounds: Retired teachers, retired government employees and senior citizens, social work postgraduates and teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors/physicians, NSS and law students, non-political service-oriented NGOs and clubs, women neighbourhood groups, Mahila Mandal, Maitri Sangh and other self-help groups, long-term prisoners who have served sentences with good conduct, and any other person deemed suitable by DLSA or Tehsil Legal Services Committee. Special Preference Categories: Exceptional sportspersons, distinguished artists, and exceptional/talented persons who have demonstrated notable skills in any field. Age Limit: Minimum age of 18 years; no upper age limit.

rows.pay: Fixed honorarium decided by authority from time to time

content_sections.heading: Enclosures

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves screening and shortlisting of applications followed by training. Selected volunteers serve a 1-year tenure from the date of successful completion of training.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Para Legal Volunteer position permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The position is on a contractual tenure basis for a period of 1 year from the date of successful completion of training.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances or HRA paid on top of the fixed honorarium?
faq.answer: No, volunteers receive only a fixed honorarium from time to time as decided by the authority, with no additional salary, pay scale, or allowance.

faq.question: Q3. Who is ineligible to apply for this position?
faq.answer: Advocates are explicitly not eligible to apply for the Para Legal Volunteer position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must have attained a minimum age of 18 years. There is no upper age limit prescribed in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be enclosed with the application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications and mark sheets, Aadhaar card, permanent residence proof issued by a competent authority, and two passport-size photographs.
